name: Corpse Slayer Flamberge Bastard Sword
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

When you hit an undead creature with an attack using this weapon, the attack deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type, and the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead until the start of your next turn.

Special. While wielding this weapon, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC against one melee attack that would hit you. You must see the attacker and be wielding the weapon.
